summary: Postal is a fully featured email server designed specifically to handle outbound and inbound mail for websites and web servers. Built using Ruby and distributed under the MIT licence, it provides a comprehensive mail delivery platform that you can self-host. It functions as a complete solution for managing mail routing, delivery tracking, and server infrastructure.
goodFor: It is a suitable choice if you need to run your own mail infrastructure to send and receive transactional emails from multiple web applications rather than relying on third-party SaaS providers.
watchOut: Running a self-hosted email server involves a high operational burden, particularly around maintaining domain reputation, handling DNS records like SPF, DKIM, and DMARC, and avoiding spam blacklists.
deployNotes: Because it runs via Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for data storage and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination securely.
